notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. Sheet D4-SA51-2 (width marker for SKT terminals, L or R): the dimensioned board is traced; the other hand is its mirror image (the sheet draws both). Layout: 490 x 490, white, R50, no border. The board is located by its drawn outline; its artwork (black stripes at 45 degrees, 99 wide) is taken from the sheet's own filled shapes (PDF fills rendered at 1000 dpi without the dimension lines, traced), ink box x 0-490, y 1-489.
